summary: CalWatt implementation complete and fully functional. All 9 features implemented per specification: core models with immutable structures, calculation service with all formulas and >80 test coverage, persistent storage with 6 sample appliances, Material 3 themed UI with 5-tab navigation, dashboard with auto-updating metrics, full CRUD appliance management, 4 interactive charts with real data, what-if simulator with savings display, and settings with rate configuration and documentation. All screens navigable and working. Sample appliances persist across app restart. No blocking issues identified.
